coastal.title: Homes, structures destroyed as B.C. wildfires burn out of control
coastal.description: In the Fraser Canyon, where three massive fires, called the Brunswick Creek Complex, are burning, the past few days have been heartbreaking for a farm owner in North Bend.

kamloops.title: Entire Village of Clinton on evacuation order due to nearby wildfire
kamloops.description: The Thompson Nicola Regional District upgraded the evacuation alert, issued on Wednesday, to an evacuation order on Friday afternoon.

kamloops.title: Evacuation order expanded in the areas of Clinton, Kelly Lake due to wildfire
kamloops.description: The order is expanded due to the immediate danger to life and safety caused by the Pear Lake wildfire, which is an estimated 1,384 hectares in size.

kamloops.title: Wildfires in B.C. prompt evacuations as hot, dry conditions persist
kamloops.description: BC Wildfire Service says the Fiftynine Creek wildfire, which is burning out of control northwest of Clinton, B.C., has grown to more than 102 square kilometres.

all.title: Canada wildfire smoke blankets US skies across the Midwest and Northeast, triggering health alerts
all.description: Air quality levels are forecast to drop to unhealthy levels across the U.S. Midwest and Northeast on Tuesday as smoke from Canadian wildfires intensifies. AirNow’s Fire and Smoke Map showed the regions blanketed in yellow due to the drifting smoke. all.title: Photos show wildfires raging across parts of British Columbia
all.description: Hundreds are out of their homes and thousands are on evacuation alert across the province, as wildfire crews battle the flames from the ground and the air.
